status: pre-execution engineering canary; synthetic finite model, not a protein result
scope: Direction-register algebra and full same-model circuit comparison; no 1089-state build, paid compute, public edits or model replacement
rates: Q_xy=2/(1+exp(U_y-U_x)) for valid nearest neighbours; Q_xx=-sum_{y!=x}Q_xy; P=I+Q/8
padding: P_xx=1 for x>=9; observable amplitudes zero there; no physical partition weight assigned to padding
shift: Swap (x,+axis) with (valid neighbour,-axis); fix stay, invalid outward direction, reserved labels and every padded-address label. Implement disjoint two-level transpositions with Gray-code X/MCX gates. No whole-walk matrix gate in compiled circuit.
conditional_loading: Lookup-based row-controlled unitary StatePreparation on3 direction qubits. All arithmetic workspace=0 at lookup level. Does not implement reversible primary-model energy arithmetic.
walk: W=(2|0_dir><0_dir|-I) A_dir^dagger S A_dir. Preserve absolute phases. Doubly controlled W factors through unconditional A/A^dagger and controlled S/reflection.
coefficients: c_k=exp(-z) I_k(z), doubled for k>=1, z=nu*time; prepare sqrt(c/sum(c)) including zero padding
left_observable: q0+0.25*q0*q1+0.1*q1^2; subtract pi mean, weight by sqrt(pi), normalize
right_observable: q1^2+0.3*q0*q1+0.2*q0; subtract pi mean, weight by sqrt(pi), normalize
components: Readout-controlled right PREP, COEF, SELECT, COEF inverse, left PREP inverse; final readout Hadamard and measurement.
comparison: Frozen v0.3.0 two-address circuit on exactly the same padded P, signed observables, K=3 coefficients and gates.

native_compile.scope: Abstract native universal basis, no named device or pulse timing
